images.prompt:
EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE into Moment A of a two-moment Project Haruka research study: a sacred world-body consciously preparing to unfold one side of itself. One complete high-intensity 16:9 cinematic anime concept illustration, no text, no panels. Research candidate only, unassigned adult character, not a canonical ability.
Use the provided image as identity, environment, palette and visual-language reference. Preserve the same dark-haired clothed adult, recognizable face and long hair, black coat/trousers, tiny dull-crimson cuff, cosmic stone-like tiers, towering sacred black axis, immense galaxies and deep black openings. Keep the whole image intensely cosmic; no grey sketch or reduced-power environment. Human figure about 40–45 percent of image height, full body visible, slightly left of center, stable three-quarter frontal stance. Strong sacred embodiment is intentional and allowed.
CRITICAL BODY RELATION: the figure is already a world-body in this FIRST moment. On the screen-right shoulder, side of ribcage and waist, the actual dark body volume and at least part of its outer silhouette consist of three deep overlapping landscape strata with a few tiny stairs and terraces. These are not little buildings stuck to an otherwise intact coat, not a removable breastplate, not a chest-window with a rectangular border. Keep the face, neck, opposite shoulder, opposite side, legs and clothing recognizable; fully clothed/nonsexual abstraction, no anatomical cavity, nudity, wounds or exposed organs. Only a few tiny architectural elements establish scale; the thick world strata are the body form itself.
POSE AND INTENT: the side containing these already-existing worlds is gently gathered inward. Both forearms are held near the chest and abdomen. The opposite hand is visibly just releasing its own wrist; no external person or force grips it. The head and attentive gaze turn toward the side about to open. Hands must be distinct and anatomically legible. Body upright and self-directed, not recoiling in pain, not tied up, not falling, no enemy or collision. The inner worlds remain visible between the forearms; they must not appear for the first time only in a later moment.
The world layers are gathered narrowly along this side while retaining depth. The immense external cosmos remains an independent backdrop of great force, not a power beam emanating from the hand. Black and cold grey-white, high contrast, low chroma, the original tiny matte crimson clothing accent only. No fresh explosion, new magical beam, light rays from the chest, halo above the head, mechanical hinges, door frames, opening coat lapels, or unfastening clothes. The action is release of one's own wrist and preparation to unfold a sacred body, NOT undressing. Preserve a strong, complete piece of art even before the next moment.
images.observed: Figure far larger than requested; body/world relationship present; self-wrist gesture not achieved.

images.prompt:

images.prompt:
EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE into Moment B of the SAME sacred world-body. Preserve exactly as closely as possible the framing, large full-body figure scale, standing position, face, hair, clothing, boots, cold black/white palette, tiny crimson cuff, external stars, immense sacred axis and ALL distant architecture. Do NOT shrink the figure, zoom, brighten the cosmos or add buildings. One complete cinematic 16:9 image, no labels.
The ONE substantive change is voluntary opening of the EXISTING near-body world: the thick upright terrace beside the neck/shoulder on screen-right must rotate outward WITH that shoulder, rib-side and waist. Its inner depths become more visible and the spacing between its near-body layers widens. The farthest already-open cosmic slabs must NOT expand further. Use the same recognizable few terrace/stair features so this reads as the same body-world changing orientation, not newly summoned buildings.
Human action: turn the screen-right shoulder and side of the torso outward in a calm deliberate self-opening. Move that elbow sideways, below shoulder height. The EMPTY palm faces obliquely back toward the opening side of their own body, NOT extended at the distant cosmos like a spell. The other arm remains gently gathered near the opposite torso, so one side is still held while one side opens. Head and gaze attend to the own opening side. Preserve readable anatomy and grounded feet, no external grabbing, enemy, incoming force or explosive event.
The world strata are not a breastplate door or a costume being taken off. That side's shoulder/rib/waist silhouette itself changes with the terraces; no intact duplicate body appears behind it. Retain a clearly recognizable face, neck, opposite arm and clothed legs. Entirely nonsexual abstract sacred anatomy: no undressing, skin exposure, anatomical wound, blood, gore or literal chest cavity. No mechanical hinge, ornamental door, new beam, glow, particle burst or hand-held object.
The before image already has a partly open world, so do not fabricate a closed-to-open miracle. Make a specific near-shoulder world surface truly turn with the body while preserving the broader scene. This is original research artwork, not an established character's canon power.
images.observed: Terraces widen; bodily initiating action not legible; one hand occluded. Hypothesis not established.
